notes: Google Drive now merges instead of replacing. Before, pulling your backup down overwrote whatever was on the device you pulled it to — so if you logged a payment on your phone and then synced your laptop, the phone's payment was gone. Payments, interest and corrections from both devices are now kept.
Anything you deleted stays deleted. A merge will not quietly bring back a payment you removed on another device.
Once you've tapped the cloud icon, the app keeps backing itself up on its own for the rest of that session — including when you switch away from it — so you don't have to remember.
The Restore button is now “Sync with Drive”, because that is what it does. If a sync ever looks wrong, “Undo sync” puts this device back exactly as it was.
